protocol.summary: The official Python wrapper delegates sensor mode/current/sample-rate and update processing to cdriver.MAX30100; the external model must provide optical raw sample FIFO and register behavior. Heart rate and SpO2 are guest algorithms, not direct host-faked sensor registers.

registers.fifo_encoding: read FIFO 0x05, four bytes IR_MSB,IR_LSB,RED_MSB,RED_LSB as confirmed by max30100_read_fifo()

gaps: FIFO timing, overflow, read-pointer and interrupt behavior still need execution coverage; raw sample byte format has been confirmed in max30100.c.
Raw optical fixtures do not establish biological, clinical or physical optical accuracy.
